responsibility: Provides higher-ranked relation support by instantiating binders with placeholders or fresh inference variables in new universes, using that machinery to check higher-ranked subtyping, and running the legacy leak check that rejects placeholder escapes across universe boundaries.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is specifically about higher-ranked binders and universes: it instantiates binders with placeholders or fresh vars and performs the legacy placeholder leak check. Unlike `infer/nll_relate/mod.rs`, which is a full alternative relation engine, this file provides the reusable higher-ranked machinery that ordinary `combine`-based inference relies on.
